in_text_mentions: The procedure was done at the age of one year old, with an endoscopic evaluation cystoscopy (used to evaluate the level of confluence, which was below the level of the lower border of pubic symphysis with a short common channel <3cm), genitography (provided an exact position of the confluence, and excluded the possible vaginal duplication), and the insertion of a urinary catheter, followed by vaginoscopy and the insertion of a vaginal catheter (Figure 1).
